provenance: Written on 11 October 2026 with an AI writing assistant (not Gemini, the model under evaluation). The same assistant designed the frame-ack contradiction-detection method, so this series is NOT BLIND: report it as a second synthetic series written after the method's prompts were frozen (frames-v1, ack-v1), not as a blind held-out test. The ground truth (decisions.csv, relations.csv, non_decisions.csv) was fixed together with the transcripts, before the system was run on them. To limit the author's bias it deliberately contains hard cases: a contradiction whose earlier option is mentioned in between without any change being agreed (G16 vs G3), a revision acknowledged only indirectly (G7 vs G2), changes agreed in one meeting and only re-confirmed later (G13, G20 vs G2), and look-alike decisions on different subjects (G11 vs G1/G17, G14 vs G2). Domain: an outpatient booking app for a hospital's clinics, used by no other evaluation series or prompt. The transcripts are LLM-written and cleaner than real meetings; the team should review them for realism before publication.

decisions.text: Appointment reminders are sent by SMS two days before the appointment.
The app launches at the Andheri clinic on 1 March.
Online payments go through Razorpay.
Patients can book appointments up to 30 days ahead.
The app supports English and Hindi at launch.
Video consultations are out of scope for version 1.
The Andheri launch moves to 15 March.
Front desk staff check every Hindi screen before launch.
The hospital's existing doctor schedule system is the source of truth for appointment slots.
The front desk can cancel appointments on a patient's behalf.
Staff receive their shift roster by email every Friday.
The booking window is extended from 30 to 60 days.
The 15 March launch at Andheri stands.
A second check-in kiosk is installed at the Andheri clinic.
Doctors can block emergency slots in the app, and the blocks sync back to the schedule system.
Card payments run on PayU.
Patients get a WhatsApp message the evening before their appointment.
Video consultations are piloted for follow-up visits in version 1.
When the front desk cancels for a patient, the patient's verbal consent is noted in the app.
The 15 March Andheri go-live is confirmed again.
